description: Who competes: which genders may enter, and whether alone or in a team.
Its place in the Games: how long it has been on the programme, how many medal events it has, whether it has a Paralympic counterpart.
What kind of sport it is and where it is contested.
Which kinds of sport are contested by whom, alone or in teams.
Which kinds of sport hold what place in the programme.
How far the programme opens each discipline to women, men and mixed teams, against how established and large it is.
The discipline as it is contested -- what sport, where, by whom -- setting aside its place in the Games.
The data themselves, the identity scale-measure (id, K).
